For your Mother's Day Beauty Event, here are the MAP restrictions you need to know from PRICE-RULES-2026-001:

**MAP-Enforced Brands (cannot be discounted without written Merchandising approval):**
- Lancome
- Estee Lauder
- Clinique
- La Mer
- Dior Beauty
- Levi's
- Coach (above $500 ticket)
- Tag Heuer

Discounts on these brands are typically only available during vendor-sponsored events. Violating MAP can result in vendor charge-backs and, in repeat cases, loss of the vendor account entirely. Per PRICE-RULES-2026-001, this is the single most cited reason for emergency creative pulls at Macy's.

**What this means for your campaign:** Your 6 selected Beauty SKUs (1406, 782, 1058, 714, 358, 934) have already been checked and cleared — none belong to MAP-enforced brands, so the 25% discount is safe. However, since your campaign copy says "Up to 25% off premium skincare, fragrance, and cosmetics" broadly, make sure no MAP-protected products are featured in the creative assets or landing page selections, even if they're not in the core SKU set.

**Best practice from FAQ-INT-2026-001:** The standing MAP list in PRICE-RULES-2026-001 can change throughout the year, so when in doubt, ask Merchandising before writing any promo headline. A past example (COMP-EX-2026-001): a "Levi's, 25 percent off this weekend" creative had to be pulled before launch and replaced with non-discount language.
